title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 1.0.0 Release Candidate 7
summary: Version 1.0.0 Release Candidate 7 replaces the stretched 43x27 machine-tile bitmaps with crisp high-resolution active and inactive monitor artwork.
changes: Replaces the original 43x27 enabled and disabled computer bitmaps with 424x216 PNG artwork matched to the machine-tile display ratio.
Uses a graphite-and-silver monitor with an emerald, blue, cyan, and violet active screen; the inactive state uses the same composition in neutral grayscale.
Keeps the accepted classic green application, title-bar, and tray icon unchanged.
Preserves all machine-matrix interaction, naming, drag-and-drop, checkbox, and connection-status behavior.
testing: Open Machine Setup at 100%, 125%, 150%, and 200% Windows display scaling and confirm both tile states remain crisp and correctly proportioned.
Enable and disable an empty machine tile and confirm its artwork changes without affecting the name field or checkbox.
Drag configured machine tiles into a different order and confirm the new artwork moves with the tile normally.
Confirm local, connected, connecting, key-mismatch, timeout, and not-configured status text remains readable and unchanged.
Open About and confirm the displayed product version is 1.0.0-rc.7.
Run the same RC7 EXE on both computers and briefly recheck mouse, keyboard, clipboard, file transfer, and reconnect behavior.
